# Jubilees Chapter 11 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 11:2 — The corruption of civilization: structural rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | Long list with "and" connectors throughout | Literal Ge'ez parataxis |
| LOGOS | Same content broken into shorter units with em-dashes | Formal English with improved readability |
| PNEUMA | "they were going to war... they ate blood... they erected..." | Active present-tense paraphrase |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. The paratactic list preserves the catalog character of the text while being readable. PNEUMA's present-tense shift creates unwarranted immediacy.

---

## 11:12 — Abram perceives error: "began to understand" vs. "began to perceive"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the child began to understand the errors of the earth" | "Understand" |
| LOGOS | "the child began to perceive the errors of the earth" | "Perceive" implies seeing through |
| PNEUMA | "From an early age Abram started seeing through the lies" | "Seeing through the lies" — interpretive |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. "Perceive" captures the Ge'ez verb of recognition/discernment more accurately than "understand" (cognitive) or PNEUMA's "seeing through the lies" (interpretive addition).

---

## 11:17 — Abram's command to the ravens

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "'Descend not: return to the place whence ye came!'" | Archaic English literal |
| LOGOS | "'Do not come down! Return to where you came from!'" | Modern formal |
| PNEUMA | "screaming: 'Don't come down here! Get back to where you came from!'" | "Screaming" added; "here" added |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. "Do not come down! Return to where you came from!" is clear and conveys authority without PNEUMA's editorial "screaming" (which is not in the source). EMET's "whence ye came" is archaic.

---

## 11:24 — "burned the house of the idols"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "he burned the house of the idols, and he burned everything in the house" | Full repetition |
| LOGOS | "he burned the house of the idols. He burned everything that was in the house" | Two sentences, same content |
| PNEUMA | "set fire to the idol temple. He burned everything in it to the ground" | "Idol temple" for "house of the idols" |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. "House of the idols" is the Ge'ez designation — it is a domestic/family shrine, not a public "temple." PNEUMA's "temple" is an over-translation. The repetition is preserved as emphasis.

---

## 11:27 — "two weeks of years" — chronological expression

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "two weeks of years" | Literal Jubilees calendrical unit |
| LOGOS | "two weeks of years" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "two weeks of years" (in text) with parenthetical clarification in notes | Same expression |

**SOPHIA:** All three agree. "Two weeks of years" = 14 years in Jubilees' system. No divergence to resolve.

---

**Total disagreements: 4 significant + 1 non-divergence**
